_: livingNpcs: macro (Idea #23, sub_projs/living-adventurers). Declare a small cast of named, persistent NPCs who live their own off-stage lives; the macro EXPANDS each into a controller-quest alias + anchor xmarkers + a deed global + a 傳唱 rumor, and ships the reusable MFLivingWorldController/MFLivingNpcAlias .pex (abstract ghost-sim + materialize-on-co-location). Adding another living NPC of an existing archetype = one more entry in livingNpcs.npcs — pure data. Here: Kjeld (adventurer) rotates between the Sleeping Giant Inn (Riverwood 0x0133C6) and the Bannered Mare (Whiterun 0x01605E); Falas (mageApprentice) haunts the Bannered Mare; the bard Bjorn voices both rumors once each NPC's deed global climbs. TEST (after package compiles the .pex on a Papyrus machine): new game / save+reload, `coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn` ↔ `coc WhiterunBanneredMare` waiting in-game hours between → each NPC materialises at his current anchor; `getglobalvalue MFLiving_MFLN_Kjeld_Deeds` climbs off-stage; talk to Bjorn for the rumor (or `set MFLiving_MFLN_Kjeld_Deeds to 3`).

npcs.name: Kjeld the Wanderer
npcs.backstory: A mercenary who left the war and now lives off contract boards across the holds.
rumors: Aye — Kjeld the Wanderer's been busy. Cleared another barrow single-handed, they say.
Folk in two holds know his name now. There'll be a song in it before long.

npcs.name: Falas Indaryn
npcs.backstory: A Dunmer apprentice of the College, forever short of coin and reagents.
rumors: That Dunmer apprentice, Falas — word is his conjurations are turning heads up at Winterhold.
